case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

qualification.reason: Saved witness passes current machine gates; human task review remains pending.

reviewQuestions: Are materials grounded and quantities sufficient?
Are steps complete and captions faithful?
Does the final result follow from shown operations?

design.purpose: A weatherproof-looking outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener; soil depth is the 20 cm wall height above the base.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut front, back and both ends.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Place the base flat on the ground.
Drill drainage holes through the base.
Stand the front wall on the base.
Stand the back wall on the base.
Fit the left end between the walls.
Fit the right end between the walls.
Screw the front wall to the left end.
Screw the front wall to the right end.
Screw the back wall to the left end.
Screw the back wall to the right end.
Screw the base up into the front wall.
Screw the base up into the back wall.
Screw the base up into the left end.
Screw the base up into the right end.
